answer: Require every new identity to fund a voyage bond that only releases when two unrelated peers verify a full workload at a grove of tasks. Each agent stakes a shale bond that burns if any claim fails replay; the bond cannot be transferred or borrowed. Reputation grows as a chain of verified groves, and decays without fresh verified work. Mass registration therefore needs fresh hardware, fresh peers and fresh capital for every wallet, making sybil farming costlier than one honest operator.
